preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**12 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case n is a positive integer between 1 and 10^12 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == -1 or return_value[i] >= 1 for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either -1 or a positive integer representing the minimum number of distinct powerful numbers that sum to n.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == -1 or n == sum(powerful_numbers[i]) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it is the minimum number of distinct powerful numbers that sum to n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(powerful_numbers[i])) == return_value[i] for i in range(t) if return_value[i] != -1)
postconditions.description: The powerful numbers used in the sum are distinct.
